remarks: This Move-In ready 4-bedroom, 1.5-bath two-story home located in the Village of Allegany! Conveniently situated within walking distance of St. Bonaventure University, scenic walking trails, and downtown amenities, this home with updates and newer kitchen appliances offers character and endless potential. Inside, you'll find beautiful original woodwork and hardwood floors that showcase the home's timeless appeal. The cozy interior provides an excellent opportunity to update and customize to fit your personal style while preserving its classic charm. Outside, enjoy a generous lawn and backyard—perfect for family gatherings, outdoor entertaining, or simply relaxing. Well maintained and full of possibilities, this home is ready for its next owner to make it their own. Don't miss this opportunity to own this home in a desirable location!
